source: West Virginia Department of Health and Human Resources, Health Statistics Center, West Virginia Vital Statistics Annual Report, 'Selected Causes of Resident Deaths: Number and Rate by County' (Table 44, 2005-2006 Table 46), one page per county, 1999-2000 and 2002-2006
note: Resident deaths (place of residence) by county as printed in the state's annual report web tables: every cell is an exact count, zeros are printed as 0, and the pages state no small-number suppression. 55 county pages per year, read in Chrome from the public pages (no file download); page headers checked against county and year. Years on the web: 1999, 2000, 2002-2006 (a 2001 edition was not found under the same address). Causes kept: all deaths, malignant neoplasms, diabetes, Alzheimer's disease (2000 on; the 1999 table has no such line), diseases of the heart, cerebrovascular diseases, influenza and pneumonia, chronic lower respiratory diseases, chronic liver disease and cirrhosis, nephritis/nephrotic syndrome/nephrosis, falls, intentional self-harm, assault (homicide) and all accidents (raw key, not a map measure). The state tables use the state's own category groupings, so exact agreement with CDC may differ for causes whose grouping is not identical (flu/pneumonia, kidney, liver). No terms of use are printed on the pages (contact line only: dhhrvitalreg@wv.gov). terms status none_stated. Counts only.
